senses.gloss: f. (קָטָה) a curtain or sheet consisting of patches pieced together, rug.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 5:10">Tosef. Neg. V, 10</cite> (Var. ed. Zuck. <cite ref="H00706"><he>חיטי</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="Q01309"><he>פְּסִיפָּס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:7">Neg. XI, 7</cite> <cite ref="S00930"><he>קיְיטָא</he></cite> (fr. <cite ref="S00286"><he>קוּט</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="S00706"><he>קִטָּה</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="S00892"><he>קִיטָּאוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00743"><he>קִיטָּיוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00917"><he>קִטָּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 8:8:5">Y. Erub. VIII, end, 25ᵇ</cite> <he>שלטון … ותלו לו קט׳</he> a governor came to Sepphoris, and they suspended rugs in his honor (connecting the columns of a colonnade; cmp. Bab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:4:2">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תלה בה קי׳</he> (not <he>תולה</he>) if one suspends rugs in the Succah (corresp. to <cite ref="O00185"><he>סדין</he></cite>, Mish. ib. I, 3). Pesik. Shor, p. 74ᵃ <he>עמודים … מכורכין בק׳</he> marble columns (statuary) wrapped in sheets; Tanḥ. Emor, ed. Bub. 8; Tanḥ. ed. 6 <he>בקניות</he> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="I00651"><he>טַפִּיטָּא</he></cite>. Y’lamd. to Num. XV, 37, quot. in Ar. <he>ק׳ של בוץ וכ׳</he> byssus curtains, purple curtains. Ib. <he>פרט לפרסין ולק׳</he> excepting (from show fringes) curtains and sheets.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:4">Am. VI, 4</cite>) <he>אלו ק׳ משופעות וכ׳</he> that means the overhanging rugs which each of them had (on their couches).
